name: Shadow Broker
ability: When played, look at opponent's hand and discard one card.
lore: A master of secrets, always trading in whispers and shadows.

name: Corporate Shill
ability: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Influence.
lore: Their pockets are lined with gold, their loyalty bought and sold.

name: Media Blackout
effect: Silence all enemy characters until end of turn.
lore: Control the narrative, control the masses.

name: Secret Society Lodge
effect: All your Illuminati characters gain +1 Attack.
lore: Where plans are hatched in the dead of night.

name: Knight Commander
ability: Other Templar characters you control gain +1 Health.
lore: A beacon of unwavering resolve on the battlefield.

name: Templar Guardian
ability: Taunt (Enemy characters must attack this character if able).
lore: Stands as an impenetrable wall against the forces of chaos.

name: Divine Smite
effect: Deal 4 damage to a target character.
lore: The wrath of the heavens, delivered swiftly.

name: Sacred Chapel
effect: At the start of your turn, heal 1 damage from all your characters.
lore: A place of solace and restoration.

name: Shape-Shifter Infiltrator
ability: Stealth (Cannot be targeted by enemy attacks or abilities until it attacks.)
lore: Blends seamlessly into the crowd, striking when least expected.

name: Psionic Dominator
ability: When played, take control of an enemy character with 2 or less Attack until end of turn.
lore: Its gaze can bend the will of the weak-minded.

name: Neural Scramble
effect: Give an enemy character -2 Attack until end of turn.
lore: Disrupts the very thoughts of its target.

name: Hidden Hive
effect: Your Reptilian characters gain 'When this character attacks, draw a card.'
lore: A nexus of alien activity, buzzing with silent intent.

name: Corporate Gauntlet
ability: Enemy characters cost (1) more Influence to play.
lore: The invisible fist that guides every election, every war, every market crash.

name: PR Operative
ability: When this character attacks, gain 1 Influence.
lore: A smile that conceals a dagger, a pen that signs away nations.

name: Black Budget
effect: Draw 2 cards. Each player discards 1 card.
lore: Where the money flows, the truth drowns.

name: Manchurian Protocol
effect: Take control of an enemy character with 3 or less Attack. It gains +2 Attack.
lore: The perfect soldier doesn't know they're programmed.

name: Bilderberg Estate
effect: At the end of your turn, if you control more characters than your opponent, draw a card.
lore: The most important meeting you've never been invited to.

name: Exorcist
ability: Destroyed enemy characters cannot be resurrected or returned to hand.
lore: Some doors, once opened, can never be closed. She makes sure of it.

name: Relic Keeper
ability: Taunt. When this character is damaged, deal 1 damage to a random enemy character.
lore: The old relics whisper secrets to those who bleed for them.

name: Holy Inquisition
effect: Silence and deal 3 damage to an enemy character.
lore: Truth is a blade — it cuts both ways.

name: Absolution
effect: Restore 5 Health to your hero or a character. Draw a card.
lore: Even the damned deserve a second prayer.

name: Holy Grail Sanctum
effect: At the start of your turn, if you have a damaged character, restore 2 Health to it.
lore: The cup that grants eternity — to those pure enough to drink.

name: Xenomorph Drone
ability: When this character destroys an enemy character, gain +1/+1.
lore: It learns from every kill. Every death feeds the swarm.

name: Abduction Specialist
ability: When played, return an enemy character with 3 or less Attack to its owner's hand.
lore: They vanish into the light between the stars.

name: Ancient Star Map
effect: Deal 2 damage to all enemy characters. Draw a card.
lore: The constellation that should not exist — points the way home.

name: Orbital Strike
effect: Deal 6 damage to an enemy character. Deal 3 damage to all other enemy characters.
lore: From orbit, no one hears them scream.

name: Underground Ant Colony
effect: Your Reptilian characters gain +1 Attack. When one of your characters dies, draw a card.
lore: Beneath the bedrock, the hive mind stirs — patient, ancient, hungry.
